decision.title: Demand-control list sizes
decision.question: Does your router enforce demand control? If so, add @listSize: slicingArguments limit (source default 10, maximum 50) with sizedFields data on lumen_books_books and lumen_books_orders; searchBooks has no size argument and Order.items has no documented maximum, so both need a number from you or the API owner.

choices.label: Router enforces demand control; add @listSize (give the searchBooks and Order.items sizes)
